exposure: Trial of vaginal delivery for Vertex/nonVertex twins
cohort: 1082 twin infants born at 24(0/7) to 27(6/7) weeks' gestation and admitted to level III neonatal intensive care units in the Canadian Neonatal Network (2010-2017)
finding: For preterm Vertex/nonVertex twins born at <28 weeks' gestation, there was no significant difference in the risk of adverse neonatal outcomes between a trial of vaginal delivery and primary cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: A trial of vaginal delivery was associated with a high rate (30%) of urgent cesarean delivery for the second twin.
